The '''Imperial Eighth Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A high-ranking officer from it was receiving cryptic messages from an anonymous source.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Crack the Code}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Update 4.1. that changed the text of many Crew Skill missions to make them faction-neutral removed the mention of the Fleet from this mission.
